Moving an interior heart with fixed shell cannot change total volume.
Uniform conservative toy mode drifts if initial common velocity is nonzero.
At alpha=beta, scalar-port nonzero frequencies are degenerate; geometry alone has not selected distinct heart frequency.
limitations: H=I incidence result is conditional, not native material dynamics.
Heart displacement redistributes volume; total breathing requires shell motion.
Scalar port law is chosen and has a free common mode; no pumping, damping, attraction or selected amplitude.
Constructor verification only; no empirical test or independent replication.
